name: Shopify Global DTC
description: The world’s premier direct-to-consumer commerce engine for independent branding, custom checkout, and global multichannel sync.
fullDescription: Shopify powers millions of businesses in over 175 countries. It provides complete ownership over customer relationships, conversion rates, and branding. From high-converting checkout experiences to multi-currency localization via Shopify Markets, it is the standard platform for independent e-commerce enterprises.
features: Industry-leading Shop Pay 1-click checkout with up to 50% higher conversions
Shopify Markets for localized multi-currency pricing, languages, and duties
App store ecosystem featuring over 8,000+ verified tools and extensions
Unified multi-channel inventory sync across Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Meta
Extensible headless architecture with Hydrogen and headless storefront APIs
